name: apolune
description: Lost Astronaut's Game Creation Framework: A massive 1800+ class 1400 file extravaganza of OpenGL, WinAPI, OpenAL and many other features, written in Visual Studio for over a decade!

paragraphs: This is the Lost Astronaut Game Creation Framework ...
... along with the commercial Apolune Game (artwork reduced from commercially available version) as an implementation example, organized as a Visual Studio (2017) solution.
We're low on our monthly LFS charges. If you can't download the code directly, or if one of these images is "broken", try downloading a Release instead.
features: It's in a space that always needs more input, so it adds value to the spaces it interacts with (software, image analysis, automation, graphics and gaming)
It would be useful for third parties who wish to produce transparent research and small independent developers who wish to learn and make games

It is solely a Windows targetted project, and is stuck in the Win32 legacy, and when the project started Windows Desktop Users represented over 76% of all gamers, but today that number is more like 24%. While useful for…
It is built on the aging OpenGL library, a tried-but-true-but-deprecated library from Khronos, and thus is stuck in the throws of that beast
It contains over a decade of distilled knowledge and shows an evolution in home PC entertainment
